title: external asset owner transfer read (loan 1 - no transfer)
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture transfer-read-loan-1-raw.json (GET /external-asset-owners/transfers?loanId=1, tenant gerege). request.loan_id=1 is the loanId of the read that produced this capture. The oracle returned an EMPTY content page for loan 1: the capture's "content":[],"totalElements":0,"empty":true. expect.empty=true is that observed page; no row cell is stated because the page has no transfer row to transcribe. Loan 6 is the discriminator: INV-01 transcribes the single row loan 6 returned, and this capture is the OTHER loan the transfer read was exercised on, so a read that answers loan 1 with any transfer (or with loan 6's row) diverges from the oracle. Nothing was computed by this promotion.
